title: International Treaties and Hungarian Law
grammar: Recap: official register for treaties and courts
goal: I can say how an international treaty becomes part of Hungarian law (*kihirdetés*).
I can say that domestic law is read in harmony with a convention (*összhangban*).
I can name the court in Strasbourg and what its judgement means (*strasbourgi bíróság*).
